name: Snaring Thread
description: Launches a visible or invisible magical tether that catches a limb, object, or fleeing target for a moment.

name: Clasp of Stillness
description: Briefly arrests a creature's motion, enough to spoil a charge, leap, swing, or escape.

name: Claim Mark
description: Places a metaphysical tag on a creature, object, or threshold, making it easier to track, hold, or later bind.

name: Tongue-Knot
description: Snags speech for a heartbeat, disrupting shouted commands, lies, chants, and verbal spellcasting.

name: Gentle Shackles
description: Summons restraints that hold without needless pain, suitable for captives, panicked allies, or controlled transport.

name: Hunter's Leash
description: Maintains directional lock on a marked target and makes fleeing beyond a set distance more difficult.

name: Chain Bind
description: Throws spectral restraints that punish struggle, casting, or rapid movement by tightening with resistance.

name: Pact Knot
description: Binds willing parties to an agreement, making betrayal or breach spiritually legible.

name: Edict Chain
description: Imposes a limited prohibition or obligation on a willing or weakened subject.

name: Prison Sigil
description: Creates a fixed binding circle or trigger-rune that roots one or more targets inside a defined area.

name: Geas
description: Lays a formal magical injunction on a subject: obey a duty, avoid an act, or suffer consequence for violation.

name: Name-Seal
description: Restricts a powerful being through its true identity, suppressing transformation, manifestation, or evasive magic.

name: Circle of Subdual
description: Establishes a wide zone in which hostile movement slows, teleportation falters, and resistance strengthens the restraint.

name: Judgment Collar
description: Places overwhelming law-force on a single dangerous target, allowing only limited action unless the binding is broken.

name: Absolute Seal
description: The supreme binding: a near-perfect metaphysical prison capable of containing a great beast, archmage, spirit, relic, or catastrophic gateway.
